title: Craft Blend 4-Mix Trio #05 (IndianMughal+TurkishIznik+SwedishKurbits+MoroccanZellige / VasarelyOpArt+PolishBoleslawiec+MexicanTalavera+VietnameseSonMai / KoreanNajeon+CzechBohemian+JapaneseMakie+FrenchLimoges)
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio.

A photograph of THREE women standing side by side on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left woman: a real adult Japanese woman in her mid 40s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, luminous glossy skin with a bright highlighter, thick black eyeliner, extremely long dramatic false lashes top and bottom, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy peach-pink lips, a confident sparkling expression, cool and composed, soft pastel-pink hair styled in many small bantu knots covering the scalp, real living eyes. Long round nails, matte finish.

Left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. An immense mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle, sagging down toward her knees under its own weight, gathering into three or four heavy rounded folds stacked one above the other, deep shadowed creases between them, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant. A gigantic bust resting on the top fold, no waist at all, colossal hips more than three times the width of her shoulders, each thigh thicker than a normal woman's waist, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's body art: Her bare skin carries 4 different painted patterns at once, together covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, each pattern claiming roughly an equal irregular share of her body rather than any straight line, zones arranged diagonally and asymmetrically. Indian Mughal miniature gold-work (a deep midnight-blue ground with fine gold linework and medallions, wide gold-and-crimson bands, dense jewel-toned scrollwork) dominates one zone. Turkish İznik tile (a brilliant white ground with cobalt-blue tulips and curling stems, wide cobalt-and-coral bands, dense floral scrollwork) dominates the second zone. Swedish Dalarna kurbits folk painting (a deep barn-red ground with bold cream and gold curling scrollwork, wide gold bands, dense curling floral scrollwork) dominates the third zone. Moroccan zellige tile mosaic (a deep cobalt ground with interlocking white, terracotta and gold motifs, wide gold bands, dense interlocking star-and-cross motifs) dominates the fourth zone. Wherever any two zones meet, the boundary is soft and diagonal rather than a straight line, motifs blending gradually across an irregular border a few inches wide, pigment on living skin throughout, face unpainted.

Left woman's pose: back fully to camera.

Left woman's footwear: extreme ballet heels, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Center woman: a real adult Latina woman in her mid 20s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, warm golden-bronze skin, a sharp black winged liner, warm terracotta eyeshadow, heavy lashes, strong sculpted contour, large dark eyes with bright real catchlights, a deep berry lip, a fiery, passionate expression, sultry, deep dark brown hair styled in curly, real living eyes. Long coffin nails, holographic finish.

Center woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. A dramatically impossible waist-to-hip ratio dominates her silhouette: a colossal heavy bust, an extremely sharply cinched waist pulled in far tighter than the waistline of any of her other curves, and then enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than that narrow waist. Gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a gigantic rounded rear. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Center woman's body art: Her bare skin carries 4 different painted patterns at once, together covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, each pattern claiming roughly an equal irregular share of her body rather than any straight line, zones arranged diagonally and asymmetrically. Vasarely-inspired optical-illusion pattern (a repeating grid of squares bulging in a 3D illusion, wide silver bands, dense optical illusion grid) dominates one zone. Polish Bolesławiec pottery (a deep cobalt ground with bold white peacock-eye dot motifs, wide white bands, dense peacock-eye dot motifs) dominates the second zone. Mexican Talavera ceramic (a glossy white tin glaze with cobalt blue and marigold medallions, wide cobalt bands, dense medallion scrollwork) dominates the third zone. Vietnamese sơn mài lacquer (deep glossy black lacquer inlaid with gold-leaf lotus blossoms, wide gold-leaf bands, dense eggshell-white scrollwork) dominates the fourth zone. Wherever any two zones meet, the boundary is soft and diagonal rather than a straight line, motifs blending gradually across an irregular border a few inches wide, pigment on living skin throughout, face unpainted.

Center woman's pose: both hands framing her own face.

Center woman's footwear: extreme platform high-heel mules, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Right woman: a real adult Hawaiian woman in her mid 20s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a natural glowing complexion, a flower tucked behind one ear, warm golden-tan skin, sultry, a distinct two-tone ombre with dark roots and a sharp transition to light ends hair styled in natural curls gathered into a high rounded puff, real living eyes. Long square nails, glossy finish.

Right woman's physique: An enormous, overwhelmingly muscular woman. Massive thick arms with heavy defined muscle, a broad powerful muscular back, a huge powerful chest, a heavy dense muscular torso and legs, only a soft hint of a waistline. Enormous round hips and colossal thick thighs with muscle visible through a soft layer, thick heavy calves. Not slim, not lean. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Right woman's body art: Her bare skin carries 4 different painted patterns at once, together covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, each pattern claiming roughly an equal irregular share of her body rather than any straight line, zones arranged diagonally and asymmetrically. Korean najeon mother-of-pearl lacquer (glossy black lacquer with shimmering mother-of-pearl vines, wide mother-of-pearl bands, dense dense scrollwork) dominates one zone. Czech Bohemian crystal-engraving motif (a deep black ground with fine engraved silver linework, wide silver bands, dense engraved floral facets) dominates the second zone. Japanese maki-e gold-powder lacquer (a deep glossy black urushi lacquer ground scattered with a traditional motif — cherry blossoms, cranes among pine, or maple leaves — rendered in fine sprinkled gold powder, wide gold-powder bands, dense gold powder glittering densely) dominates the third zone. French Limoges enamel (a deep cobalt-blue ground with fine white and gold grisaille scrollwork, wide gold bands, dense grisaille scrollwork) dominates the fourth zone. Wherever any two zones meet, the boundary is soft and diagonal rather than a straight line, motifs blending gradually across an irregular border a few inches wide, pigment on living skin throughout, face unpainted.

Right woman's pose: leaning against a wall just out of frame.

Right woman's footwear: extreme plain stiletto pumps, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, all faces toward the camera.

Lighting: the blended painted patterns reading crisp against each woman's skin, the hard raking light carving every fold and curve. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 4:5 8K.
